currentCoordinate.coordNote: The canonical point is the deterministic half-length point of the 46.2-metre named Hausmanns gate segment along the Hauskvartalet frontage. It represents the street axis, not Hausmania as a building and not the separate Brenneriveien/Ingens gate area.

previousCoordinate.reasonReplaced: The old point was an unsupported editorial proxy for a diffuse environment. A finite named street segment and official frontage controls now resolve the canonical axis.

identity.resolvedIdentity: The Hausmanns gate street frontage through Hauskvartalet, approximately the named street segment along Hausmanns gate 34, 40 and 42, used as a stable physical axis for changing posters, stencils, facade marks and DIY visual culture.
identity.identityProblem: The editorial description referred broadly to Hausmannsgate and side streets, but Hausmania and Brenneriveien/Ingens gate already exist as separate canonical places. Verification therefore requires a route geometry that represents the street frontage without duplicating either neighbour.
identity.splitReason: The street-front segment provides one coherent route identity. Individual venues and the Akerselva-side Brenneriveien area remain separate canonical places.

requiredEvidence: exact address controls for the Hauskvartalet frontage
explicit duplicate control against Hausmania and Brenneriveien/Ingens gate

evidence.finding: Way 129061331 is a named Hausmanns gate road segment approximately 46.2 metres long. It runs along the frontage controlled by Hausmanns gate 34, 40 and 42. The deterministic half-length point is 59.91930402696448, 10.75166160598796.
evidence.reason: Provides the finite stable route geometry that the earlier scope audit lacked.

evidence.finding: Kartverket returns one active Hausmanns gate place-name object in Oslo, stedsnummer 995873, with approved and prioritized Norwegian spelling and MultiLineString street geometry.
evidence.reason: Officially confirms the named street identity independently of OSM.

evidence.finding: Hausmanns gate 34 is at 59.919148209457326, 10.751977548509613, approximately 7.8 metres from the applied route geometry. This is the existing Hausmania canonical address.
evidence.reason: Controls the western Hauskvartalet frontage while preventing the route record from replacing the Hausmania building place.

evidence.finding: Hausmanns gate 40 is at 59.919303875414755, 10.751753198638816, approximately 4.3 metres from the named street segment.
The current 42A/B/C address family lies along the eastern end of the same street frontage; 42A is approximately 6.8 metres from the route segment.

evidence.sourceName: Oslo kommune – Byøkologi og kultur i Hauskvartalet

evidence.reason: Defines why the 34–42 street frontage is the relevant finite axis rather than an arbitrary segment of the full street.

evidence.finding: The previous coordinate 59.9189, 10.7513 lies approximately 49.3 metres from the applied route midpoint and had no source-backed geometry or finite anchor set.
evidence.reason: Replaced by the finite named street segment.

decision.nextAction: Applied the named Hausmanns gate 34–42 frontage segment midpoint as the canonical route anchor, kept Hausmania and Brenneriveien/Ingens gate separate, and narrowed the radius to the finite Hauskvartalet street axis. Continue with kolstadgata_toyen_vegger.

notes: The canonical point moves approximately 49.3 metres to the named Hausmanns gate route segment.
The radius decreases from 240 to 100 metres because the diffuse editorial scope is now resolved to a finite 46.2-metre street-front route.
Hausmania remains a separate building canonical at Hausmanns gate 34.
Brenneriveien/Ingens gate remains a separate Akerselva-side area canonical.
Changing posters, graffiti and stencils are content evidence, not coordinate sources.
